review: No chorus field. Refrain 1:5 repeated in all four stanzas. 'سُحقت' read as 'blotted out' (English bridge) → נִמְחוּ; 'قداستي بري' → 'my holiness, my righteousness' → קְדֻשָּׁתִי, צִדְקָתִי. Glossary: פִּדְיוֹנִי, לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כַּדּוֹנַג (Ps 22:15).
